annotations.title: Link to view a media file

description: A private link to one ready media file, to look at it or download it (open it to check a video or photo before putting it in a post). Anyone holding the link can open it until it expires (an hour unless expires_in says otherwise, up to 7 days), so never paste it anywhere public.

id.description: ID of the media file (a UUID): from media_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_link
title: Link to view a media file
